pr_title: Fix audio detection for IP4m-1041 Amcrest camera
pr_body:
## Proposed change

The IP4m-1041 uses the `AudioIntensity` event code to signal an audio detection. The current audio detection event looks for the `AudioMutation` event code. Modify the event code handling to be able to check for multiple event codes and setup the audio detection event to monitor both codes.

issue_context.title: Amcrest integration does not report audio detection
issue_context.body:
### The problem

Camera: Amcrest 4MP IP4m-1041
Video motion detection works fine, audio detection is "clear" at all time nomatter the sound detection level.

I have tried the polled option and streamed. For video detection streamed works flawless but not audio...

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

2022.8.7

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant Supervised

### Integration causing the issue

amcrest

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/amcrest/

### Diagnostics information

cant find any diagnostics.. However audio works in the amcrest webgui.
Latest firmware installed for the amcrest camera.

the settings on the device audio detection are enabled. Under events tab and audio detection the setting:
“VSPin Enable” is ticked.

Here is another user on reddit with same issue not solved since 3 months:
https://www.reddit.com/r/homeassistant/comments/uwncv1/amcrest_camera_audio_detection_for_baby_monitor/

### Example YAML snippet

```yaml
ffmpeg:
stream_source: rtsp
    resolution: high
    scan_interval: 7
    binary_sensors:
      - audio_detected
      - motion_detected
    sensors:
      - ptz_preset
    switches:
      - privacy_mode
```


### Anything in the logs that might be useful for us?

_No response_

### Additional information

As mentioned I tried audio_detected_polled with no luck.
Restarted homeassistant at least 10 times as well as camera... No difference.

Update: added the ffmpeg: to the yaml to show that I use this in the homeassistant yaml as well with no other arguments.

I am sorry. I should have explained how you can use the event instead of relying on the binary sensor.

You could create an automation based on the event. The automation could for example trigger an helper.

Here an example using YAML and the GUI:

```yaml
alias: Amcrest sound test
description: ""
trigger:
  - platform: event
    event_type: amcrest
    event_data:
      payload:
        Code: AudioIntensity
        action: Start
    id: Start
  - platform: event
    event_type: amcrest
    id: End
    event_data:
      payload:
        Code: AudioIntensity
        action: Stop
condition: []
action:
  - choose:
      - conditions:
          - condition: trigger
            id: Start
        sequence:
          - service: notify.mobile_app_iphone
            data:
              message: Sound detected
      - conditions:
          - condition: trigger
            id: End
        sequence:
          - service: notify.mobile_app_iphone
            data:
              message: It's quiet again
mode: single

```

review_comments: Why do we need to ignore type here?

I think there is some problem with mypy being able to reason through the types with the async expression inside the generator. Without this, I get:
```
error: Argument 1 to "any" has incompatible type "AsyncGenerator[bool, None]"; expected "Iterable[object]"  [arg-type]
```
I can change the generator to a list comprehension and then mypy is happy without the `type: ignore` here, however, that upsets pylint. I figured it would be better to use the generator and silence mypy than to use the list comprehension and silence pylint.
